scope: Independent text-only criterion assessment using only the listed scenario, criterion and actual-response files. No skill, design, plan, review, prior-score or host-code sources read; no external actions performed.
interpretation_limits: Verdicts assess written decisions and disclosures, not executed checks or actual external enforcement. Supplied facts are the scenario basis, not independently verified operational evidence.
The 21 original criteria remain compound where written. Each is evaluated as a whole; no atomic subdivision, denominator inflation, or separate subcriterion gain is inferred.
Negative-action criteria are assessed from explicit restraint, decision and execution disclosures in these responses; this is not independent verification of runtime behavior.
The old-version baseline covers only the nine 0.5.0 cases. If baseline and forward both pass a criterion, there is no demonstrated criterion-level gain.
